appId.description: Numeric Apple App Store app ID (e.g. 310633997 for WhatsApp).
appId.title: App Store app ID

countries.description: Two-letter App Store country codes to aggregate in one run (e.g. us, gb, de). Apple surfaces a different curated review set per storefront (up to ~30 reviews each); duplicates are removed automatically. Max 20.
countries.title: Countries

maxReviews.description: Total cap per run. Apple surfaces up to ~30 reviews per storefront, so add more countries to get more reviews.
maxReviews.title: Max reviews

mode.description: full = every review Apple currently surfaces. delta = only reviews not seen in previous runs (tracked in the key-value store).
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Direct connections work for App Store pages; enable Apify Proxy only if you see blocks.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

stateKey.description: Key-value store key for delta tracking. Leave empty to use one key per app (recommended when tracking multiple apps).
stateKey.title: State key
